caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden panel featuring the image of a haloed male figure with a beard, dressed in a light-colored robe with a blue collar and red inner lining visible at the lower edge of the garment. The figure stands upright and holds a long staff in his left hand while his right hand is held against his chest, with a red-colored object tied to the staff. The figure's face is rendered with dark hair and beard, wide eyes, and distinct dark eyebrows. The main colors in the composition are pale beige, brown, and red, giving the image an earthy tone overall. The rectangular panel has darker, roughly sketched borders, and a semicircular section at the top displays a stylized floral motif painted in brown and yellow tones. The background of the panel is a muted, uneven brown, and faint, indistinct circular objects or markings can be seen at the upper left and right of the main figure. The entire drawing is centered on a plain, off-white background.
title: Santo
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
